metadata.description: Proposed deployment map. Twyns publicly describes a hosted cloud platform and iOS/Android use; hosting provider, region, tenancy, app distribution method and exact interfaces are not verified. Offer groupings beyond the public product labels are analytical, not claimed SKUs.
